datasetVersion.termsOfUse:
The standard Data Transfer Agreement (DTA) used at the Erasmus MC must be signed without adjustments. This DTA template has been set up in conjunction with legal advisors of all Dutch academic hospitals and serves to facilitate and regulate the transfer of/access to personal data that were previously collected by a Dutch University hospital (“Provider”) from patients, participants and/or volunteers for the purpose of scientific research, by an external not-for-profit party (“Recipient”).
Data transfer agreement: https://elsi.health-ri.nl/sites/elsi/files/2020-07/20.30815%20OenO%20Template%20-%20Data%20Sharing%20Agreement.pdf
datasetVersion.specialPermissions: Access to the dataset can be requested through the ‘request access’ button. A Data Transfer Agreement (DTA) in line with GDPR regulations and/or a Collaboration Agreement should be signed before data is shared. Only data requests in line with the Terms of Use will be taken into consideration.
datasetVersion.conditions: To access and use the dataset please read the Terms of Use and the Terms of Access.
datasetVersion.termsOfAccess: Only data requests in line with the Terms of Use will be taken into consideration. The standard Data Transfer Agreement (DTA) in line with GDPR regulations and/or the Collaboration Agreement should be signed before data is shared. If a data request is approved, the data will be delivered in a safe and secure manner. By signing the DTA and/or Collaboration Agreement and accessing the Materials, the recipient represents his/her acceptance of the Terms of Use.

files.description: This file lists the abundances of each pathway in the community, also in RPK units as described for gene families. For details on the calculation of pathway abundances from constituent gene family abundances, see the HumanN3 User Manual. Like gene families, pathways are broken down into per-organism contributions when possible (again delineated by the | character), with the total read abundance consisting of pathways assigned to organisms, UNMAPPED reads, and UNINTEGRATED reads.
files.label: 230228_MG2022002002_pathabundance_combined.tsv

dataFile.description: This file lists the abundances of each pathway in the community, also in RPK units as described for gene families. For details on the calculation of pathway abundances from constituent gene family abundances, see the HumanN3 User Manual. Like gene families, pathways are broken down into per-organism contributions when possible (again delineated by the | character), with the total read abundance consisting of pathways assigned to organisms, UNMAPPED reads, and UNINTEGRATED reads.
